_meta.source: Compiled from public agricultural extension service guidelines (ICAR, TNAU, KVK)
_meta.disclaimer: These are general guidance references. Always consult local agricultural extension officers for region-specific recommendations.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove and destroy affected leaves. Improve air circulation.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply copper-based fungicide (Bordeaux mixture 1%). Remove severely affected parts.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Apply systemic fungicide (Metalaxyl-based, consult local extension). Remove and burn affected plants.

cultural_practices: Ensure proper plant spacing for air circulation
Rotate crops — avoid planting Solanaceae in the same field for 2-3 years
Tomato___Late_blight.monitoring_note: Re-scan affected plants after 7 days to track progression.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove lower affected leaves. Mulch around base to prevent splash-back.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply Mancozeb-based fungicide as per label dosage. Improve drainage.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Apply combination fungicide treatment. Remove severely affected plants.

cultural_practices: Mulch around plants to prevent soil splash
Water at base, avoid wetting foliage
Stake plants for better air circulation

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove affected lower leaves. Improve air circulation.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply chlorothalonil or copper-based fungicide as per label.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Intensive fungicide program. Remove heavily infected plants.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove affected leaves. Avoid overhead watering.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply copper-based bactericide. Use disease-free seeds for next planting.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Copper + mancozeb combination spray. Remove severely affected plants.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.monitoring_note: Bacterial diseases are harder to control. Re-scan after 10 days.

severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply Mancozeb or copper fungicide preventively.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb combination. Destroy severely infected tubers.

Potato___Late_blight.monitoring_note: Late blight spreads rapidly. Re-scan within 5 days.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove lower affected leaves. Maintain adequate fertilization.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Intensive fungicide program with rotation of active ingredients.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove mummified berries. Prune for air circulation.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply Mancozeb-based fungicide before bloom. Remove affected clusters.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Intensive fungicide program from bud break. Remove all infected material.

cultural_practices: Remove mummified fruit from vines and ground

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove fallen leaves. Monitor new growth.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply protectant fungicide during wet periods.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Intensive spray program. Remove severely affected fruit.

cultural_practices: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn
Apply urea to fallen leaves to speed decomposition

severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply foliar fungicide if in early growth stages.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Apply strobilurin or triazole-based fungicide. Consider yield impact.

severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply foliar fungicide if before tasseling.

severity_guidance.LOW: Remove affected plant parts. Improve growing conditions and air circulation.
severity_guidance.MEDIUM: Apply appropriate fungicide or pesticide as per label. Consult local extension office.
severity_guidance.HIGH: Seek advice from a local agricultural extension officer for targeted treatment.

cultural_practices: Remove and destroy affected plant material
default_treatment.monitoring_note: Re-scan affected plants after 7 days to track disease progression.
